li.p: Push the sunroof switch rearward to the first detent position, the sunroof glass opens. However, if the power sunshade is in close condition, the power sunshade will open first. Push the sunroof switch forward to the first detent position, the sunroof glass closes. However, if the sunroof glass is in close condition, the power sunshade will close.
Push the sunroof switch forward or rearward to the second detent position, the power sunshade and sunroof glass both close or open.
To stop the sunroof movement at any point, push the sunroof switch in any direction.
